placeResult.name: Mérito
placeResult.description: MERITO's unassuming two-story space wants to stay as far away as possible from pretention and formality, using natural materials that give a cozy yet simple ambience. The kitchen is exposed for everyone to see and has a coal oven that uses carob tree wood. Every dish served in this restaurant passes through the coal oven. The Merito experience can be quite close and personal when seated by the bar. You will witness every move the kitchen team makes while prepping, cooking and plating each dish. MERITO is a contemporary and modern space, that reflect a feel of easiness. Its cuisine’s creativity and heart beats through the blends and fusions of the origins of the South American continent, it’s common ground, to go back to the basics in order to transform what’s daily and common into magic.
placeResult.neighborhood_description: Barranco stands as Lima's bohemian hub, where artists and musicians flock to find inspiration amongst the colorful colonial architecture and beautiful sea views. The area's main square, Plaza de Barranco, is surrounded by charming cafes and hip bars, with the iconic Puente de los Suspiros or "Bridge of Sighs" offering a romantic walkway above. The Museo de Arte Contemporaneo and the Pedro de Osma Museum present rotating exhibits of modern and colonial art respectively, while the Dedalo Arte craft store offers unique artisanal treasures. Culinary enthusiasts can indulge in Peruvian delicacies at Isolina or sample craft beers at Barranco Beer Company. Conveniently, the neighborhood is easily accessible via the Metropolitano rapid bus system.

reviews_list.title: A truly unique dining experience you won’t want to pass up while you’re enjoying your stay in Lima, Peru.
reviews_list.snippet: My husband and I enjoy trying local cuisine and new experiences with dining options. Well this place is certainly one of those places. The menu is thoughtful and exciting but not overly daring. The food is Peruvian but with international influences. And yet they offer a classic flan that I swear is the BEST you’ll ever have!!! The ambience is great for a couple or small group in this quaint setting. The experience will be unforgettable for sure!!

reviews_list.title: Outstanding
reviews_list.snippet: The food was sublime. Truly outstanding technique and flavor combinations. The setting was demure and relaxing cannot recommend enough

reviews_list.title: Highly enjoyable
reviews_list.snippet: We had a excellent lunch experience. After eating two tasting menus in a row, we switched to à la cart in the morning. We are super grateful for that. We’re also thankful that the staff was so easy to accommodate us. The à la carte menu has a lot of different options. The waitress was able to make recommendations on what we should order. The scallops with sankey is definitely a must have. I probably could’ve eaten another couple of those. It was so light and refreshing. The Popeye crab was also very interesting with almost thai flavors, very balanced. The fish curry was cooked perfectly. The different flavors mixed with the pani puri bread was super fun. The rice with squid was also very well thought out. The fresh peas added the texture that it needed. It was a homey and very thoughtful dish. Thankfully, we received room for dessert. The flan is the best flan I’ve ever had in my entire life. The custard was luxurious and luscious on the tongue. Definitely a highlight. The grilled custard apple with such an interesting dish. It was fun to eat and had a great almost pancake toast on the bottom, topped with a grilled custard, apple, topped with a crisp of the custard apple. On the side, there was almost this goat cheese/funky ice cream, which really complimented everything. It was by far one of the most interesting and flavorful dishes.

reviews_list.title: Best meal of my life
reviews_list.snippet: Without a doubt the best meal of my life.  I do not say that lightly as I live in New Orleans and have been to many fabulous restaurants there.  I also have lived in Philly and travel so have had the privilege to try many restaurants other places.  Flavors were out of this world and the combinations of food, flavor, and texture was outstanding.  We also did the South American wine pairing which was the perfect compliment to every course.  Staff were the ultimate professionals.  This in itself would have made for the most memorable night on our trip, but when we struggled to catch an uber due to no international cell service plus construction in the area Chef Martinez himself came out to help us, walked 2 blocks with us, and only left once we got into the car.  So not only is he one of the best chefs in the world but a kind and helpful man at his core.  If you travel to Lima your trip will not be complete without a stop at Merito.

reviews_list.title: Amazing
reviews_list.snippet: Best meal in Lima, hands down. I unfortunately did not do many other fine dining or highly acclaimed restaurants during my trip, but Merito exceeded already high expectations. Each dish was an adventure: beautifully presented and all tastes amazing. Some dishes surprised me with textures and flavors. The service was attentive and very professional. The cocktails were fantastic. Ambience and music very tasteful. Price is amazing for what you get. Highly recommended

reviews_list.title: Merito a great fusion food experience
reviews_list.snippet: Merito was an excellent experience in fusion food. The atmosphere was casual. The wait staff were excellent. They explained each dish. Gave recommendations and were there to answer any questions. I would highly recommend Merito. The food presentation was unique and food was delicious.

reviews_list.title: Acidity
reviews_list.snippet:
I start from food: as per the title, acidity. Nothing more. Each dish had a constant, this acidity foretold so much that, at the end of the ten courses, it was all so obvious in taste that boredom had taken over. Every single dish ended with this sour tone and all this was repeated again and again. 

Atmosphere: Medium/high music and very loud cold air conditioning made the room uncomfortable. Beautiful lighting. 

Service: our table was tied, for service, to another table, so, if we had not yet finished the other table had to wait and vice versa. In addition, we were served by 4 different waiters who could not explain the ingredients used (except superficially) while the explanation of the ingredients was supposed to be the main focus of this experience. 

Disappointment is so much also because it seems to enter a temple of cuisine and everything tries to be so perfect that then at the end of dinner you do not have much left except, precisely, this immense disappointment. The price is high, the disappointment more!

reviews_list.title: Fantastic, amazing, sensational….I could go on.
reviews_list.snippet:
This was bought as a 40th wedding anniversary gift by our 3 adult kids as they knew that we were coming to Peru and our son had eaten there a few years before.
The building is unusual in that you walk through the kitchen with a chefs table and taken upstairs to the restaurant itself. It does have the industrial vibe with bare bricks etc but our table and chairs were comfortable. We were having the 10 course tasting menu and the staff were very attentive to my allergen request of no onions. 
Each course was fantastic with Peruvian ingredients the majority we had never heard of. The flavours were amazing as well as having playful variations in texture and colours. Each course was explained by the staff with advice how to eat it to get the most out of each course.
By the sixth course I was feeling full and was worrying whether I would be able to finish the menu but the chef’s playfulness came into its own and I finished the meal just right.
We had a bottle of Albariño which complemented the food. 

The meal was simply stunning on all levels and entered my top 10 meals eaten out and we have eaten in quite a few Michelin star restaurants including Arzak, Gordon Ramseys and L’Enclume and is was as good as them.

Sat near us was an American guy sat by himself having the same menu taking photos.
We met him outside and had a quick chat about the meal. He had visited a  world renowned restaurant around the corner and said this meal was one third of the price and twice as good- I think that summed up the whole experience for us.

reviews_list.title: Exquisite Flavors & Outstanding Service at Merito
reviews_list.snippet: Merito is a must-visit in Lima! The food is exquisite-each dish bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. The service was top-notch, and the staff’s recommendations were spot on. The chefs went above and beyond by customizing non-veg dishes into delicious vegetarian options. A perfect blend of creativity, taste, and warm hospitality. 💖

related_stories.description: As the gateway to all that Perú has to offer, Lima is often mistakenly treated as a layover city, with travelers jetting off to Cusco as quickly as they can. By doing so, they miss the rich history the country’s capital city has to offer: both ancient and modern-day art, a shopping mall with incredible ocean views, and world-renowned cuisine.
